description: Source file for dialog-related functionalities in the Wesnoth game, including unit advancement, save/load dialogs, unit descriptions, and campaign previews.

classes.name: delete_save
classes.description: Handles deletion of saved game files with user confirmation.

classes.name: save_preview_pane
classes.description: Displays a preview of saved game data including map, leader, and metadata.

classes.name: unit_preview_pane
classes.description: Displays a preview of a unit, including image, description, and stats.

classes.name: campaign_preview_pane
classes.description: Displays a preview of campaign scenario descriptions and images.

methods.name: advance_unit
methods.description: Advances a unit to its next form, with dialog options for the player.

methods.name: animate_unit_advancement
methods.description: Animates the visual transition of a unit advancing.

methods.name: show_objectives
methods.description: Displays the objectives for a level in a dialog.

methods.name: get_save_name
methods.description: Prompts the user for a save game filename, with overwrite confirmation.

methods.name: load_game_dialog
methods.description: Displays a dialog to load a saved game, with previews and options.

methods.name: unit_speak
methods.description: Displays dialog messages from units matching certain criteria.

methods.name: show_unit_description
methods.description: Shows help information for a specific unit.

methods.name: save_preview_pane::draw_contents
methods.description: Draws the save game preview including map, leader, and metadata.

methods.name: campaign_preview_pane::draw_contents
methods.description: Draws the campaign scenario description and image.
